Take It Slow — Sometimes it’s hard to clear our minds in the midst of a busy day, to give ourselves the space we need to be able to contemplate our work. Learn to slow yourself down. You can apply the idea of ‘slow motion’ to anything you normally do quickly and without thinking, from slow-motion walking to cleaning your teeth to doing the washing up. See how slowly you can do one task. Think about each movement — make each one feel deliberate. As you settle into the rhythm of the task, your breathing should become deeper and slow down to coordinate with your movement. Pay attention to what your whole body is doing. Once you’ve mastered going slow in life, you can try it with your art.
